scope: 15 cm uniform stairs, 15 up + platform + 15 down, 45 degrees

replayed_support_measurements.method: Replay full saved input sequence from saved integration state. Sum world-frame contact force on each wheel over the final 1 second. All three final physics_qpos errors are 0. Forces below are rounded to 0.01 N.

gravity_measurements.method: Separate MjData with final saved qpos, qvel zero, ctrl zero, mj_forward; no trajectory modification.

limitations: All runs are diagnostic failures, not successful dataset episodes.
No full route reached platform or descent.
Absence of enabled contact reports does not exclude robot self-intersection; collision masks disable self-collision.
Wheel-center force Jacobians do not replace actual contact-point force and torque calculations.

most_informative_cases.finding: Speed 2 rad/s and wheel P40 remove the initial rocker speed violation; route still stalls near x1.63.
Positive rocker move actually executes and releases middle wheels, but transfers more vertical load to rear wheels.
Release then negative swing establishes middle support; average rear support remains about689N and rear wheels stay before first edge.
One middle wheel crosses; other rocker stalls near0deg. Zero-velocity gravity bias on lagging rocker is -99.8726Nm against -100Nm actuator saturation.
Synchronization reduces left/right mismatch to about1-3deg but neither middle center fully crosses; next riser also blocks wheel.
Other-side front support is established and PRESS executes. Front support then vanishes before middle support forms; both rear wheels remain blocked. Full independent replay qpos/qvel errors are0.

observability_notes.note: Assist events were empty; these are not valid executed active-policy contrasts.

Only unilateral front acquisition executes; the historical EMA/goal sample fields are unreliable due to shared references. See diagnostic_notes.json and independently recomputed support_replay_audit.json.
50N is a controller transition trigger, not a quality threshold. Historical samples now copy mutable values. PRESS does execute.

final_candidate_support_evidence.interpretation: The new front support does not unload rear wheels enough or hand off support to the free middle wheel. This is a failed controller candidate, not a proof of global physical impossibility.
